title: 第196章 全都在争宠第195章 雌性的地狱
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
他们把她带到了8号买主面前，竟然是个两百斤重的猪兽人。
季欢看到他就想吐了，更无法接受，以后要被他睡，还要给他生孩子。
季欢在他们松开她的一瞬间，她蓦地跳了起来，蹦到了空中，再往门口处飞去。
她竟然能兽化了，长了出了两只天鹅翅膀，就这样在众目睽睽之下，飞出了黑市。
季欢出了黑市之后，就摔在了地上，她紧起身，想要再飞，却使不出灵力了。
她扭头往门口处看，大批的保镖涌了出来。
他们手里还拿着枪，她吓得只能快速往外跑，往暗处，往巷子深处跑。
季欢一直跑一直跑，累得不行了，还是一直跑。
直到后面听不到那些保镖的声音了，她才敢停下来。
看到旁边有一栋废旧的房子，她准备先躲到里面。
现在是夜晚，到处一片漆黑，这个地方，连路灯都没有。
她感觉像生活在末世。
季欢进到废楼里，她胆子很小的，可是现在，没人可依靠。
她只能靠自己，害怕是没用。
她轻手轻脚的进到屋内，找了一间有门的屋子，进到里面，把门关上，竟然还有锁，她上了锁，又抬了屋内的破沙发和柜子抵上。
弄完这一切，她靠在沙发坐到地上，也不管脏不脏了。
此时的她，只想好好休息一会。
明天天一亮，她就出去，得查清楚，这是什么鬼地方？
并且，她要想办法在这个地方活下来。
……

帝王星，裴氏私人医院。
裴西川和谢京墨站在电梯门口等电梯。
两人看到彼此的时候，眼底都有了一丝暗色，倒相嫌弃的在想，他怎么在这里？
谢京墨神情冷然，压迫感很强，他还穿着军装。
路过的人还跟他打招呼。
“指挥官！”
“指挥官！”
他对着他们淡淡的点一下头，算是回应。
裴西川一身黑色西服，系了季欢送的那条领带。
他冷哼一声，“指挥官，你好像很闲嘛！这个点，不是应该在军营练兵吗？就不怕以后打败仗？”
谢京墨带龙军之后，从无败绩。
整个星际都很崇拜他，以前裴西川也崇拜的，觉得他是真雄性！
可是现在，他一点也不崇拜了，甚至还想在季欢的面前诋毁他。
很想说别看指挥官高大威猛，其实他不举。
content_en:
They brought her to buyer No. 8, who turned out to be a 200-pound pig-orc.
Ji Huan felt like vomiting when she saw him, and she couldn't bear to accept that he would sleep with him and give birth to his children.
The moment Ji Huan let go of her, she suddenly jumped up, jumped into the air, and flew towards the door.
She was able to transform into a beast, sprouted two swan wings, and flew out of the black market in full view of everyone.
After Ji Huan left the black market, she fell to the ground. She stood up tightly and wanted to fly again, but she couldn't use her spiritual power.
She turned to look at the door and saw a large number of bodyguards pouring out.
They still had guns in their hands, and she was so frightened that she could only run out quickly, into the darkness, and deeper into the alley.
Ji Huan kept running and running. He was so tired that he kept running.
She didn't dare to stop until the voices of the bodyguards could no longer be heard from behind.
Seeing an abandoned house next to her, she planned to hide inside first.
It's night now, it's dark everywhere, and there aren't even street lights in this place.
She felt like she was living in the apocalypse.
Ji Huan was very timid when she entered the abandoned building, but now, she had no one to rely on.
She can only rely on herself, there is no use being afraid.
She entered the house quietly, found a room with a door, went inside, closed the door, and there was a lock. She locked it, and then lifted the broken sofa and cabinet in the room to close it.
After doing all this, she leaned on the sofa and sat on the floor, not caring whether it was dirty or not.
At this time, she just wanted to take a good rest.
She will go out at dawn tomorrow and find out, what the hell kind of place is this?
And, she has to find a way to survive in this place.
…
Emperor Star, Pei's Private Hospital.
Pei Xichuan and Xie Jingmo stood at the door of the elevator waiting for the elevator.
When the two of them saw each other, there was a hint of darkness in their eyes, and they thought with disgust, why is he here?
Xie Jingmo's expression was cold and oppressive. He was still wearing a military uniform.
People passing by said hello to him.
"Commander!"
"Commander!"
He nodded lightly to them as a response.
Pei Xichuan was wearing a black suit and the tie Ji Huan gave him as a gift.
He snorted coldly, "Commander, you seem to be very idle! At this point, shouldn't you be training in the military camp? Aren't you afraid of losing the battle in the future?"
After Xie Jingmo led the Dragon Army, he never suffered a defeat.
The entire galaxy admires him. Pei Xichuan also admired him before and thought he was a true male!
But now, he doesn't admire him at all, and even wants to slander him in front of Ji Huan.
I really want to say that the commander is tall and mighty, but in fact he is not tall.
